## What Sets Us Apart?
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Book-Icon.png)
###  Premium Canadian Education 
Maple Bear’s curriculum, inspired by Canada’s renowned educational practices, takes a whole-child approach, blending academic rigor with creativity, self-expression, and critical thinking. Our bilingual programs integrate Language Arts, math, science, and social studies, nurturing cognitive, emotional, and social growth while fostering a lifelong love of learning. 
[ Learn more ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/premium-canadian-education/)
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Check-Mark-Icon.png)
###  Own Curriculum 
The Maple Bear curriculum is created in Canada by Canadian experts, the Maple Bear Faculty – a distinguished team of 150+ expert Canadian educators. Responsible for writing the curriculum, faculty members continually update the material to reflect the latest in research and Canadian educational practices. 
[ Pre-school Program ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/preschool-program/)
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Monitor-Icon.png)
###  Future-Ready Skills 
At Maple Bear, we prepare students for the future by nurturing essential soft skills. Through our innovative Canadian education model, these skills are seamlessly integrated into daily learning, empowering students with the confidence and emotional intelligence to thrive in a rapidly evolving world. This dedication to holistic, future-ready education is at the heart of our mission. 
[ Learn more ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/premium-canadian-education/#Future_Ready_Skills)
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Grad-Cap-Icon.png)
###  Billingual Education 
Bilingual education is the use of two different languages in the classroom instruction of academic content. At Maple Bear, students study all academic subjects in either their native language or a second language, depending on the subject and grade level. Research shows that immersion is the best method of learning an additional language. 
[ Learn more ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/bilingual-education/)
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Ribbon-Icon.png)
###  Quality is Assured 
Maple Bear schools benefit from our distinguished academic faculty of Canadian trainers, curriculum writers and quality assurance personnel. Each school undergoes annual inspections to ensure safety, academic excellence, and quality facilities. Our goal is to establish schools that provide a secure, enriching learning environment designed to prepare students for a bright future. 
[ Teachers Trainings ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/teachers-trainings/)
[ Academic Review ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/academic-review/)
[ Operational Review ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/operational-review/)
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Graph-Icon.png)
###  Hybrid not International 
Maple Bear schools comply with local education regulations, blending Canadian methodologies with the local curriculum. This dual approach ensures students are locally grounded yet globally minded, seamlessly transitioning between the Canadian and local systems at any point during the educational cycle. 
[ Learn more ](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/our-accreditations/)
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Maple-Leaf-Icon-White-Version.png)
## Mission
The Maple Bear mission is to deliver a student-focused learning system in a safe, secure and stimulating environment that prepares students for success at the post secondary level and that instills a passion for life-long learning.
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Maple-Leaf-Icon-White-Version.png)

## Citizens of the World
As educators, we have a responsibility to nurture the next generation of leaders. At Maple Bear, we teach personal responsibility inside the classroom as part of your daily routine and global awareness outside of it.
Soft skills and character building are just as important components of the curriculum as are academic subjects. We believe that to face the challenges of the future, we need young people who can think critically and solve problems creatively beyond having good academic performance.
The Maple Bear program teaches tolerance and mutual respect from the earliest years, integrates leadership explicitly in the later years, and consistently encourages students to participate in community service and social responsibility initiatives.
![](https://sofia-kindergarten.maplebear.bg/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/DZ2_6347_e_Test1-1-scaled.jpg)

## What our Parents Say

# Admission Policy
At Maple Bear, we strive to create a welcoming and inclusive environment for all families while ensuring that every child is set up for success within our bilingual education framework. Our admissions process is designed to provide a smooth and transparent experience for parents and students. Below are the standard steps to follow when applying to our school/ kindergartens. requirements):
## 1
###  Schedule a Visit 
The first step in the admissions process is to schedule a visit to our school. This visit is an opportunity for you and your child to explore the Maple Bear environment, meet our team, and gain a deeper understanding of our bilingual curriculum. During the visit, you will have the chance to ask questions and see our classrooms in action. 
## 2
###  Visit with Your Child 
We encourage parents to visit the school along with their child. This allows your child to get a feel for the school atmosphere and engage in introductory activities. Our team will also have the opportunity to observe your child in an informal setting, ensuring a smooth transition should they join the Maple Bear community. 
## 3
###  English Language Assessment (if applicable) 
Depending on the grade level and the school's requirements, your child may be asked to complete an English language assessment. This assessment helps us understand your child’s language proficiency and readiness for our bilingual program. The need for this test varies, and our admissions team will inform you if it is necessary. 
## 4
###  Final Approval 
Once all steps have been completed, including the school visit and language assessment (if applicable), our admissions team will review the application. You will be notified promptly regarding the admission decision. If approved, the next step will be to complete the enrollment process via our parents portal and prepare for your child’s first day at Maple Bear!

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
If you have additional questions, feel free to contact our admissions office. We are here to assist you with any questions regarding tuition, fees, and the enrollment process.
Are there any discounts available for siblings? 
Yes, we offer a 5% sibling discount for the second child enrolled and a 10% discount for twins.
Are uniforms included in the tuition fees? 
No, uniforms are not included. Uniforms can be purchased separately through our Maple Bear Official Online shop.
What is the withdrawal and refund policy? 
Refunds vary depending on the timing of withdrawal. Please refer to our school’s refund policy or contact the admissions office for more details.
How can I make payments? 
Payments can be made via bank transfer.
Is there an additional fee for extracurricular activities? 
Extracurricular activities are at additional costs which vary depending on the activities.
Are meals included in the tuition fees? 
Meal plans are not included in the tuition fees but are available for an additional charge. Students can also bring their own lunch box. Meals are ordered directly via the FURISTO webpage.
What happens if tuition payments are delayed? 
If payments are not made by the due date, a late fee may be charged. Continued non-payment could impact a student’s enrollment. Please contact our finance office if you need to discuss payment arrangements.

## Uniforms 
All Maple Bear students are required to wear an official Maple Bear uniform every day. Maple Bear uniforms are an integral part of the Maple Bear school experience. They foster a sense of:
## 1
###  BELONGING 
Uniforms increase the sense of belonging to a community and help to develop school spirit and pride. 
## 2
###  EQUALITY 
Wearing uniforms is a way to mitigate the visibility of the economic, social or cultural differences between students, and they are more cost-effective for families. 
## 3
###  DAILY ROUTINE 
Uniforms make it easier for the parents and children in their daily routine. The Maple Bear uniforms are made with high quality cotton materials and child-safe textiles. Quality control is conducted through on-going certification and on-site audits. 
## 4
###  SAFETY 
Uniforms increase student visibility to help ensure safety of children during day trips or activities outside the centre. Uniforms also make it much easier to identify individuals who might not belong on school grounds. At Maple Bear centres, safety is the number one priority. 
## 5
###  FOCUS 
Uniforms stimulate the daily focus of children at the Maple Bear education center and allow creativity to come from educational choices, not consumerism. 
## 6
###  EDUCATION ROUTINE 
Uniforms simplify the daily routine for children by making the mental transition from their home to kindergarten/ school easier. 
## Commitment to Quality and Safety
The uniforms of Maple Bear School Name are produced Turkey, one of the largest cotton producers in the world, with a significant portion of its textile production exported to Germany. Our providers, designer and manufacturers are collaborating with top dyeing and fabric companies in Turkey, working for brands like Burberry, Lacoste, Ralph Lauren, Hugo Boss. The company producing the uniforms is specializes in children’s uniforms for various school brands across Europe and Turkey.
All our providers are certified OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100. OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 is a renowned independent certification within the textile and fashion industry. If an item carries a STANDARD 100 label, it certifies that every element is free from harmful substances, having been meticulously tested against 350 toxic chemicals.

## Communication
At Maple Bear School Name we use Kinderpedia as our main communication platform. Some of the useful features that Kinderpedia offers are:
  * **Real Time Updates:** Parents are updated in real time and this makes them feel like they’re a part of their child’s day at kindergarten or school, no matter where they are.
  * **Quick Communication:** With both options quick messages and live chat, parents can communicate with the school from anywhere.
  * **Students Development:** The school communicates all achievement and important milestones in students development and skills in a comprehensive and clear way. Parents have a better insight into the school’s curriculum and its implementation.
  * **Important Documents and Invoices:** Parents can find all necessary important information in the platform.

# Frequently Asked Questions 
We know that starting a new school journey is exciting, and we’re here to support you every step of the way. Below are answers to some common questions parents often have when joining the Maple Bear family.
## General School Information
What curriculum does Maple Bear use? 
Maple Bear Kindergarten Sofia uses a blended curriculum that integrates both the local and Canadian educational standards. This unique approach combines the Canadian teaching methodology with the local curriculum, providing students with a bilingual education in both the local language and English. Our program emphasizes critical thinking, creativity, and global awareness, equipping students with the skills they need to excel in a rapidly changing world.
How does Maple Bear approach bilingual education? 
We use an immersion approach, introducing English (or another second language) gradually and in natural contexts. The goal is to help students become proficient in both languages without sacrificing their native language skills.
When is it optimal for children to begin learning a second language? 
There is an optimal period where acquisition of a new language is uncomplicated and almost effortless. This period starts in infancy and goes to approximately age 7. After that it becomes increasingly difficult, and by adulthood, learning a new language is highly challenging. Brain science explains this phenomenon.
We know that the language center in the brains of young children is still developing. In fact, their brains are like sponges. At school, they absorb information unconsciously, unaware they are learning a second language. This is because their brain is still growing: a baby’s brain is busy creating trillions of connections called synapses, which are formed through stimulating experiences and caring relationships
What is the student-to-teacher ratio? 
Class sizes vary by school grade, but we maintain the recommended by the Maple Bear Canadian Academic team student-to-teacher ratio to ensure attention and a safe, nurturing learning environment.
## Admissions & Enrollment
How do I apply to Maple Bear? 
To apply, please complete an online application form on our website or contact our admissions office for more details. We will guide you through the application, interview, and enrollment process.
Is there an age requirement for admission? 
Yes, age requirements vary by grade level. Typically, children should be three years old to enter Preschool, with other grades requiring similar age-appropriate placements. Contact our admissions team for specific requirements.
Are there any entrance exams or assessments? 
Our admissions process may include an assessment or interview, depending on the grade level, to ensure we understand each child’s learning needs and can support them effectively. English language assessment and recommendations might be also requested.
## Tuition & Fees
What is included in the tuition fees? 
Tuition generally includes core educational programs. However, extracurricular activities, uniforms, and Student Learning academic materials and meals may have additional fees. Contact the Admission office for a detailed breakdown.
Are there any discounts for siblings? 
Yes, we offer a sibling discount. Contact our Admissions office for details on the discount structure at your specific Maple Bear location.
What are the payment options for tuition fees? 
We offer various payment options, including annual, semester, and monthly plans. Payments can be made by bank transfer.
## School Life & Daily Essentials
Do students need to wear a uniform? 
Yes, uniforms are required. By wearing uniforms, our Maple Bear students develop a sense of belonging and reduce economic, social, or cultural differences between them. Uniforms stimulate the daily focus of children at the Maple Bear education center and allow creativity to come from educational choices, not consumerism. Maple Bear uniforms are made of high-quality cotton materials and textiles safe for children and are there to facilitate the daily routines and security of the Maple Bear Students.
Are meals provided? 
Meal plans are available for an additional fee and included breakfast, fruit refreshments and lunch, or students may bring their own lunch. Our meal programs emphasize balanced, nutritious options.
What time does school start and end? 
School hours vary by location, but generally, the school day begins between 8:00-9:00 am and ends around 5:00-6:30 pm.
## Academic Programs & Support
How are students assessed? 
Maple Bear uses continuous assessment methods focusing on individual growth and skill development. We provide regular progress reports and schedule parent-teacher conferences to keep you updated on your child’s progress.
Does Maple Bear offer special education support? 
Our inclusive approach strives to support diverse learning needs. Please contact the Maple Bear school Academic Team to discuss specific requirements and questions.
What extracurricular activities are available? 
Maple Bear offers a variety of extracurricular programs, from sports and arts to language and STEM clubs. These activities may vary by location, and some may have additional fees. Please contact the Admissions office or check the Parents Essentials section.
## Health & Safety
What health and safety measures are in place? 
Student safety is a top priority. We adhere to strict hygiene and safety protocols, including regular cleaning, secure school entry, and trained staff for emergencies. Health checks and emergency procedures are regularly reviewed and practiced.
Are there provisions for medical emergencies? 
Yes, we have trained staff on-site to handle minor injuries and emergencies. In case of a serious incident, parents will be contacted immediately, and emergency medical services will be called if needed.
How does Maple Bear handle food allergies and dietary restrictions? 
We work closely with parents to ensure children with allergies or dietary restrictions are accommodated. Please inform us of any specific needs during enrollment and admission process.
## Communication & Parent Involvement
How can I stay updated on my child’s progress? 
Maple Bear schools maintain open communication through parent-teacher meetings, regular progress reports, and a Digital platform (Kinderpedia) where parents can access important updates, homework, and other school communications.
How can I get involved in school activities? 
We encourage parent involvement! There are various opportunities for parents to volunteer, participate in school events, and join parent advisory groups.
Are there any CSR activities? 
Maple Bear Schools engage in a variety of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) activities to foster community development, environmental stewardship, and social awareness among students. Here are some examples of CSR initiatives:
  * Global Connections for Sustainability
  * Terry Fox Annual School Run
  * Holidays support activities (Holidat Heroes, and others)
  * And many more implemented in the Maple Bear Curriculum.
